concerns.text: T104 requires the convergence monitor to flag iterations with 'tolerance < 1e-4', but no task defines or produces a 'tolerance' field: T101's convergence-log record schema is [iteration_id, sample_size, converged, max_iterations, error_message]. The monitor's second flag condition has no producing task/field, so that check is uncoverable as specified. Either add tolerance to T101's log schema or drop the tolerance condition from T104.
